node.statement: By the definition of a_n, ||T_n(X)||>=a_n||X|| for every X in M_n tensor S_P; applying this with X=Z^dagger dot Z and then citing lem-hcb3-uniform-square-lower yields ||T_n(Z)||^2 >= [a_n*(1-K_sq*e)-C_prod*e]||Z||^2. Taking the infimum over nonzero Z gives a_n^2>=A*a_n-B. Since A^2-4B>=0, the quadratic x^2-Ax+B is nonnegative at x=a_n>=0, so a_n lies outside the open interval between its roots: a_n<=r_- or a_n>=r_+.
